======
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

In compliance of the order dated 06.02.2023, opposite party no.2 is physically present before this Court and submitted that a compromise between the parties took place and she is residing with the petitioner.
Petitioner is not present as he is not well.

In view of the aforesaid, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.43242 of 2022(6) dt.20-02-2023 surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Complaint Case Ashok Yadav @ Ashok Prasad Yadav vs The State Of Bihar on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133224275/
